# knowledge

Generated project-local adapter for GitHub Copilot agent skills. Do not edit this file directly.

This adapter requires the full Annifity repository root. Do not install or copy this adapter folder by itself.

Canonical source: skills/knowledge/SKILL.md

When this skill triggers:

1. Read skills/knowledge/SKILL.md from the repository root.
2. Follow the canonical instructions exactly; if this adapter conflicts with the source, the source wins.
3. Load only the referenced _refs/ files needed for the current task.
4. Match the user's language by default; Annifity is designed for Vietnamese and English PM work.
